name: Tiszaszentmárton (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged near the top with a pale blue oval bearing the municipal arms of Tiszaszentmárton (a green shield with a white church and waves) below the name Tiszaszentmárton.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
